title: Robert Saleh’s plan for Will Levis after quarterback’s lost Titans season

sources.title: Robert Saleh’s plan for Will Levis after quarterback’s lost Titans season
sources.description: Titans head coach Robert Saleh spoke to reporters at Tuesday’s NFL Scouting Combine in Indianapolis, where he touched briefly on what he’s looking for in a backup quarterback behind Cam Ward.
